values.label: standard 5V (factory default)
values.description: An incoming voltage of approx. 0.5 volts will trigger KICK LANCET at a fixed volume.

values.label: standard 5V + accent
values.description: A voltage between approx. 0.5 and 5 volts will trigger KICK LANCET at a fixed volume. Voltages between 5 and 10 volts will trigger a second, fixed accent volume.

values.label: standard 5V + dynamic
values.description: A voltage between approx. 0.5 and 5 volts will trigger KICK LANCET at a fixed volume. Higher voltages (5-10 volts) are interpreted dynamically. At 10 volts, the full volume will be reached.

values.label: dynamic
values.description: KICK LANCET will be dynamically triggered, depending on the trigger voltages, ranging between 0.5 and 10 volts.

values.label: fixed volume
values.description: The sound of KICK LANCET will be triggered with a fixed volume, independently from intensity of the input signal.

values.label: dynamic (factory default)
values.description: KICK LANCET will be triggered dynamically, depending on the volume of the input signal.
